name: TABLET DISINTEGRATION TESTER
desc: Pharmacopoeia-Compliant Double-Basket Digital Tablet Disintegration Test Apparatus engineered for automated disintegration time evaluation. Features a dual basket configuration driven by a stable 30 RPM mechanical drive and a PID temperature controller utilizing dual stainless steel PT-100 sensors.
features: Full structural compliance with IP, USP, and BP pharmacopoeia protocols
2 Station assembly managing Double Basket setup (2 × 6 test tubes matrix)
High-stability fixed speed tracking at 30 strokes per minute (30 RPM)
Auto lift-up mechanism parking both baskets at top position upon test completion
Microprocessor preset countdown timer from 00.01 to 99.59 Hours with audio alarm
